app.title: Family expenses
ask.example1: How much went on cafes over the summer?
ask.example3: What did Maria spend the most on this month?
ask.example4: Compare grocery spending over the last three months
ask.hint: Ask about spending in plain words. The AI sees only statistics and purchases and cannot change any data.
ask.placeholder: For example: how much did we spend on taxis in October?
ask.title: Questions
bank.hint1: Upload a statement as CSV or PDF. The AI finds expenses and income in it and compares them with what is already recorded: the same amount within two days from another source counts as the same operation. Nothing is saved until you press “Record”. The owner is determined by the last digits of the card, which can be set in Settings → Family.
bank.hint2: Mark a transfer to a family member as “Family: name”. It counts neither as spending nor as income, and the name from the bank is remembered, so later transfers to that person are recognised on their own. Transfers between your own accounts and top-ups from your own card are unticked by default.
bank.marked: . Past transfers within the family found: {{count}}
bank.no_debits: No debits found in the statement.
bank.none_yet: None yet. Statements uploaded on the web or sent to the bot will appear here.
bank.reading: The AI is reading the statement, this can take up to a minute…
bank.title: Bank statement
budgets.hint: A monthly limit in euros. A budget on a top-level category covers all its subcategories. The bot writes to the group at 80% and when the limit is exceeded.
categories.hint: The AI picks a category from this list. Only an unused category can be deleted.
categories.income_hint: An income gets its category from the description: “salary” goes to “Salary”, “refund” to “Refunds”. Everything else goes to “Other income”; the category can be changed in the record.
dashboard.family_hint: Transfers to family members, not spending
dashboard.title: Statistics
family.hint1: Group members appear here on their own after their first message to the bot. Add a child or another family member without Telegram by hand. Then an expense can be recorded for them in the group: + Maria: cinema 12. The name in the bot is written as it is here; the first word is enough.
family.hint2: Several values can be entered in the fields below: type and press Enter or a comma. Cards: the last 4 digits. A bank notification and a statement line with this card are booked for this person. Mail: all addresses the person forwards electronic receipts from.
family.hint3: Name in the bank: how the bank writes this person in transfers, for example Vera Maslennikova. Transfers to and from them count as transfers within the family and are neither spending nor income. Otherwise pocket money for a child would be counted twice: at the transfer and when they spend it. Past transfers are recalculated too.
family.language_hint: One language for the whole family: the interface, the bot, reports and the AI's answers. Names of the standard categories are translated; ones renamed by hand stay as they are.
family.marked: Transfers within the family found: {{count}}. They were removed from spending.
import.delete_text: All records added from this statement{{count}} will be deleted. Other expenses are not affected.
llm.env_hint: Changed in the .env file, then restart the service.
llm.order: In each list the models go in order: the next one is used if the previous did not answer.
llm.task_strong: Re-read a receipt when the sums do not match
llm.title: AI
llmp.alert: The bot warns the group when less than {{sum}} is left (LLM_BALANCE_ALERT).
llmp.charged: Charged by OpenRouter: today {{day}}, this month {{month}}
llmp.deepseek_hint: To see the balance of your DeepSeek key, put it in .env as DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and restart the service.
llmp.free_left: Free requests to :free models left today: {{count}}
llmp.google_hint: There is no balance: the free tier limits the number of requests per minute and per day, not money. How many requests went through your key is shown below in the “own” column.
llmp.usage_hint: “OpenRouter” was charged to the OpenRouter balance. “Own keys” was paid with your keys at the providers (BYOK) when OpenRouter routed the request through them. Amounts in dollars, as the providers count them. Requests are counted since the log was switched on.
login.not_configured: Sign-in is not set up. Set BOT_TOKEN or WEB_PASSWORD in .env.
login.telegram: Sign in with Telegram. Members of the family group have access.
manual.desc_expense: Can be left empty, for example when only the amount is visible in the bank
manual.desc_income: For example: salary, side job, refund
other.mail_checked: Last check: {{when}}. Receipts from mail since start: {{count}}.
other.mail_disabled: Off. To turn it on, set IMAP_HOST, IMAP_USER and IMAP_PASSWORD in .env.
other.mail_text: Mailbox {{address}} on {{host}}. Forward electronic receipts to it: the bot checks the mailbox every {{minutes}} min and writes about each receipt in the group.
other.report_hint: Sent to the group automatically on the 1st at 9:00. It can also be sent by hand.
products.grouping: Grouping names in the background: {{count}}. Refresh the list in a minute.
products.hint: The same product is named differently in different stores. The AI merges such names itself after every receipt. You can fix it by hand: tick the products and press “Merge”. Price per unit in euros.
products.merge_text: {{names}} will be treated as one product.
products.pick: Pick a product on the left
products.title: Price trends
receipt.delete_text: The receipt, all its lines and the photo will be deleted permanently.
receipt.note_hint: For a single-line record the description becomes its name
receipt.peer_remembered: Transfers of “{{name}}” are now always within the family
receipt.remember_peer: Remember: “{{name}}” is this family member. Their transfers, past and future, will be within the family.
receipt.remember_tooltip: The new category will apply to this product in all receipts and future purchases
receipt.transfer_note: Transfer within the family{{peer}}. Not counted as spending or income.
receipt.transfer_text: The money stayed in the family: such a transfer counts neither as spending nor as income. For example, pocket money for a child: they will spend it themselves, and that spending will be counted.
receipts.import_only: Only expenses added from one bank statement are shown
receipts.title: Receipts
recurring.day_hint: 31 in a shorter month means the last day
recurring.hint: Rent, internet, subscriptions, as well as salary and other regular income. On the right day of the month a record appears automatically and the bot tells the group.
recurring.nothing: Nothing to record: all is already counted
settings.title: Settings
warranty.hint: The AI marks warranties on electronics and appliances: the term from the receipt, or 24 months for things over €30 if there is none. {{days}} days before it ends the bot reminds the group. The term can be corrected in the receipt line.
warranty.title: Warranties
